Name: Ppanyagteuli's Gender Swap Penny Portraits and Hoesjibnyaong's Matching Sprites
Author: ryecci
Description:
[url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/430331]Original portraits[/url]﻿ by 빠냑트리. [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/398426]Original sprites[/url] by 횟집냐옹. 빠냑트리 has given their permission to let others use freely except for commercial use, so thank you very much! As always, if any of the original artists wants me to take this down, I will do so immediately!

Made originally for personal use. Changed the clothes in the portraits so they'd be consistent with the sprites. Also created beach sprites in the same style since they're missing. Added the rest of the beach portraits expressions and added winter outfit portraits. 

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]to change the portraits. For the sprites I just replace the original xnb files since I don't know how to do API modding, but I've also included the png files for those that know or prefer to use them.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
